I fixed the failing test, "adds 21% tax, rounded to cents". All 4 tests pass now.

The problem was in `addTax` in `src/money.ts:5`. Its comment says it rounds to cents, but it didn't round at all, so `addTax(19.99)` returned `24.1879` instead of `24.19`. The fix rounds the result to two decimal places:

```ts
return Math.round(netAmount * (1 + TAX_RATE) * 100) / 100;
```

This works for normal amounts. But ordinary decimal numbers can't store some values exactly, so a few amounts ending in a half cent may round down instead of up. If this is real money code, it would be safer to do the maths in whole cents.
